title: GMI nuclear theme research composition v1
description: The closed response of the pure Nuclear research composer. It uses the shared theme-research envelope, public synthetic assertions only, fail-closed shared rights resolution, no arithmetic, no ranking and no authority.

generation.description: 'gen_' + sha256(canonical JSON of {definition_version, rights_revision, sorted revision_tuple, slice_key, view, time_mode, source_cutoff, recorded_cutoff, anchor_theme_id})[:32]. offset/limit/expected_generation are EXCLUDED — pagination never changes the fingerprint, and an out-of-scope assertion never perturbs it.

native_subjects.description: Source-local selectors only — a selector is unique within its source namespace and two similar labels from different sources are never merged. No global product id exists anywhere in this response.

href.description: The client owns hrefs; the composition emits only the native ids.

role.description: 'subject' for ordinary rows; 'announced_party' for announced ownership without an evidenced effective date; 'owner_from:<date>' only when a REPORTED_FACT carries business_valid_from; 'owner_reported_effective_date_unknown' for a reported completion whose effective date is unstated. Never 'supplier_to' from a catalog capability. v1 serves NO directional announced side: 'announced_seller' and 'announced_acquirer' are retired and unreachable - eleven independent reviews each inverted a parse of the curator's free text, so the direction is not derived at all rather than derived wrongly. Do not branch on them. A direction returns only when the shared curation assertion carries it as a structured curated enum (object.subject_role), the standing v1.1 request.

security.description: Non-null ONLY for an identity row with resolution RESOLVED and a non-null security_id; every unresolved shape keeps evidence and roles but no price/valuation/portfolio join.

rows.description: Ordered by (source_business_label, company_node_id) — stable source order, never by any magnitude.

management.description: Nuclear v1 has no management-sequence witness: the economics VIEW carries the financial observation rows, this SECTION stays the guidance witness slot and is unavailable.

evidence_refs.description: Only SELECTED (authorized) assertions — including rows excluded from current views by review state, supersession or syndication collapse — plus the caller's opaque native refs passed through. Never a withheld count.

note.const: counts only what this principal may know exists

limitations.description: Every composer limitation token. Nuclear-specific codes include `supplemental_basket_witnesses`, `milestone_predicate_unavailable`, `syndicated_collapsed`, `target_windows_judged_at:`, `witness_cohort_excluded:`, and `unmapped_rights_source_excluded:`; parameterized tokens retain the shared wire grammar.

input_refs.description: The exact revision strings the section consumed — sorted, never ranked.

text.description: Assertion summaries use only limitations.coverage; establishes and does_not_establish stay on their rows.

stale.description: Present only on stale interpretations: text is prefixed '[stale interpretation] ' while the newly supported observation stays visible elsewhere in the response.

items.description: One directed edge per (assertion, relation); reciprocal roles stay separate directed edges with different relation_kind — never merged, never deleted as a cycle. The label carries the meaning; color is not a field.

value.description: Always null — the composer never sums rows; mixed configurations, periods, denominators, units and bases make any total a double-count hazard.

reason.description: 'totals_not_computed' when the view carries rows; null when there is nothing to compute.

selector.description: Source-local subject selector (subject product when labelled, else the subject business).

object_selector.description: Source-local object selector, scoped by publisher — two similar labels from different documents never merge.

model.description: Always null in Nuclear v1: no structured publisher model field exists on the assertion yet.

stage.description: Null in Nuclear v1 unless derivable verbatim from the source.

retrospective.description: True only in source_history mode for archival sources recorded later than their publication.

stock_flow.description: Copied verbatim — a backlog stock is never relabelled a lead time.

measure_scope.description: Always null in Nuclear v1; the financial basis lives in period/denominator/unit/gross_net_basis, kept as separate row fields.

purchase_total.description: Always null in Nuclear v1 — the composer never builds a cost total.

purchase_total_reason.description: 'purchase_boundary' marks the integrated-assembly/contained-component double-count refusal for later consumers that attempt totals.

object_configuration.description: A quantity row is bound to THIS configuration; a row for another configuration never inherits it.

source_clocks.description: Source publication, observation and retention clocks plus the business-validity window — publication is never collapsed into business validity and an unknown publication stays null at its grain.

current.description: False exactly when a successor correction inside this selection supersedes the row; held, rejected, and expired rows are excluded from views and are absent from evidence_refs.

independent_source_count.description: Syndicated copies collapse into the original's count and are listed under corroboration_refs, never counted.
